label: Customer Health Score Calculator
description: Aggregates customer engagement signals (product usage, support interactions, NPS, commercial activity) to produce a health score with at-risk identification and recommended actions.

guidedInputs.label: Engagement signals (describe what you know)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the customer's engagement across any of these dimensions:
- Product / service usage (increasing, stable, declining, low adoption?)
- Support interactions (ticket volume, severity, resolution satisfaction?)
- NPS or satisfaction scores (recent score, trend?)
- Communication frequency (regular check-ins, or going quiet?)
- Executive engagement (are senior contacts engaged or disengaged?)
- Commercial signals (expansion requests, budget discussions, or contract queries?)
- Reference activity (willing to be a reference or case study?)
- Training / onboarding completion?

guidedInputs.label: Key contacts and relationship health
guidedInputs.placeholder: Who are the key people on the customer side and how strong are our relationships? Include any changes (new stakeholders, departures, reorgs) that could affect the relationship.

guidedInputs.label: Recent notable events
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Had a major support incident last month, New CTO joined 3 months ago and is reviewing all vendors, Just completed a successful project delivery, Missed their last QBR, Mentioned competitor during last call
